chapters.label: The first big chance
chapters.text: Paris, 2022, the Champions League final. Liverpool in red, Real Madrid in white. Thiago slides a pass to Sadio Mané. He zips inside and shoots!

chapters.label: Watch the save
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Thibaut Courtois stands tall and set, then flies across at full stretch. His fingertips push it onto the post!

chapters.label: It stays out
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the ball rolls along the line, but stays out! Courtois made nine saves. Real Madrid won the final!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn, keepers: stay tall and spread wide, so the shooter sees less goal. Then stretch: even fingertips count!
